narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Fives make every number short, so it needs only a few symbols.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Five times shorter is still long when the number is large.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Count the fives carefully before you decide how long the row is.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Count how many groups fit, and write that many group signs.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>One group size alone gives long rows for big numbers.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. A system counts only in tens. How many ten signs does six hundred forty need?
